description: This file defines a NurseProvider class that manages the state of a NurseProfile object, including loading, updating, and adding credentials, using Flutter's ChangeNotifier for state management.

classes.name: NurseProvider
classes.description: A state management class for NurseProfile, providing methods to load, update, and modify the profile data.

methods.name: loadProfile
methods.description: Simulates loading a nurse profile asynchronously and updates the state.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates the nurse profile with new data and notifies listeners.

methods.name: addCredential
methods.description: Adds a new credential to the nurse profile's credentials list and updates the profile.
